answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the falcon is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the whisper of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. The marble ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 476os.
